data.name: Twisted World
data.creator_notes:
The idea of this world is you are a 15 year old male (hence the shota tag) born into a place where (for some reason) men are very rare. Because of this, men are allowed to do whatever they want to any female in the world. 
I tried  to give the user a sense of freedom in the world with what they want to do. If you're more darkly inclined I recommend checking out the "Red Room" which can be contacted for the darker things you get up to in the world and can be used to threaten women with 'reeducation' to compel obedience. The Mall also has various shops that attract different personalities you may want to check out. Or you may decide to go to school to find out what trouble to get up to.
If you have any suggestions on things and how to fix issues, please let me know. This is my first card, and I've tinkered with it a bit to get fair results in my opinion. On ChatGPT after awhile it can get fairly repetitive and robotic unfortunately, but that may just be a limit of it. I did my best to not make the token limit larger than needed for world info. (I used other cards for inspiration for how to model this one.)

If you have an issue with the card (or just want to share your adventure) feel free to message me on Discord with it at Auramil#0716 so I can do some troubleshooting.
